questions.question:
[지문]
B: Jimin, look! That red phone case looks nice!
G: (가)You can say that again! Mom would love it as a birthday present.

ⓐ I don't agree. Look! It works as a wallet, too.
ⓑ Really? That's so expensive!
ⓒ I wonder how much it costs.
ⓓ Oh, I didn't see that. Then let's buy it for Mom.
ⓔ Let me see. It costs 40,000 won.

G: Okay. I'm delighted to buy something special for Mom.
B: So am I.

대화의 자연스러운 흐름에 따라 ⓐ~ⓔ를 바르게 배열한 것은?
questions.explanation: 대화의 흐름: ⓒ 얼마인지 궁금하다 → ⓔ 40,000원이다 → ⓐ 동의하지 않는다, 지갑으로도 쓰인다 → ⓑ 정말? 너무 비싸다! → ⓓ 오, 못 봤다. 그럼 엄마를 위해 사자. 순서가 자연스럽다.

[지문]

위 대화에서 (가)와 바꿔 쓸 수 없는 표현은?
questions.explanation: 'You can say that again!'은 '정말 그래요! 동의해요!'라는 표현이다. ⑤ 'I'm afraid I don't agree.'는 '유감스럽지만 동의하지 않는다'는 뜻으로 반대 의미이므로 바꿔 쓸 수 없다.

questions.question:
[지문]
G: Oliver, what club are you going to join?
B: I'm not sure. How about you, Sora?
G: I want to join the school dance club.
B: Really? But I heard you're preparing for an animation high school.
G: Right, but I need some time to relax. We all need to do something to get over stress.
B: You can say that again.
G: Why don't you join me? I'll be fun.
B: No, thanks. Dancing is not for me. I have two left feet.

밑줄 친 부분(No, thanks. Dancing is not for me. I have two left feet.)이 나타내는 의미로 가장 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: 'No, thanks. Dancing is not for me.'는 Sora의 제안을 거절하는 표현이다. 'I have two left feet.'는 '나는 춤을 잘 못 춘다'는 관용적 표현으로 거절의 이유를 나타낸다.

options: Oliver는 애니메이션 고등학교 진학을 준비하고 있다.
Sora와 Oliver는 같은 동아리에 가입할 것이다.
Sora는 춤추는 것을 좋아하지만 그림 그리기는 싫어한다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Long ago, an honest merchant lived in Genoa, Italy. His name was Antonio, and he went to different places to support his family by trading. One day, he filled his ship with goods and visited a faraway island. There he traded tools for spices and books for nuts. Thanks to Antonio, the islanders could get ⓐwhat they needed.

One night, Antonio had dinner with the island's queen at her place. When dinner was served, rats appeared, and some servants chased them away with sticks.

Antonio was greatly surprised that there were rats in the palace. He asked, 'Are there no cats on this island?' The queen looked puzzled. 'ⓑWhat is a cat?' she asked. The merchant said to himself, 'ⓒWhat the islanders here need is not tools or books, but cats.' He brought two cats from his ship and let them Ⓐrun free. 'ⓓWhat amazing animals!' cried the queen when she saw all the rats Ⓑrun away. She gave Antonio a chest that was filled with jewels.

ⓐ~ⓓ 중 용법이 동일한 것을 있는 대로 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ 'what they needed'는 선행사를 포함한 관계대명사(명사절)로 '그들이 필요한 것'이라는 뜻이다. ⓒ 'What the islanders here need'도 동일하게 선행사 포함 관계대명사(명사절)이다. ⓑ 'What is a cat?'의 What은 의문사, ⓓ 'What amazing animals!'의 What은 감탄사이다. 따라서 ⓐ와 ⓒ가 용법이 동일하다.

Ⓐ와 Ⓑ에 들어갈 동사의 형태가 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: Ⓐ: 'let them run free' - 사역동사 let 뒤에는 목적격 보어로 동사원형을 쓴다. Ⓑ: 'saw all the rats run away' - 지각동사 saw 뒤에는 목적격 보어로 동사원형(또는 현재분사)을 쓴다. 따라서 둘 다 run이 맞다.

options: Antonio는 교역을 통해 그의 가족을 부양했다.
여왕은 Antonio에게 보석으로 가득 찬 상자를 주었다.
Antonio가 여왕과 저녁 식사를 하려는데 쥐가 나타났다.
Antonio는 먼 섬에서 도구를 향신료로, 책을 견과류로 바꿨다.
섬사람들은 그들이 필요한 것들을 다양한 방법으로 얻을 수 있었다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Back in Italy, Antonio told his friends about his good fortune. Luigi, the richest merchant in Genoa, heard the story and was jealous. 'Cats are worthless,' Luigi thought. 'I'll bring the queen what is really valuable. I'm sure that the queen will give me more jewels.'

Luigi packed his ship with wonderful paintings and other works of art. He took the gifts to the island. To get a chance Ⓐto meet the queen, he told the islanders a lie that he was a good friend of Antonio's. When the queen heard about Luigi, she invited him to her palace for dinner. Before sitting down at the table, Luigi presented the queen with all his gifts, and the queen thanked him again and again. 'I'll repay you with a priceless gift,' said the queen.

Luigi watched the queen whisper in a servant's ear. He became excited and hopeful. He was sure that he would receive more jewels than Antonio.

After a while, the servant returned with a box, and the queen presented it to Luigi. When Luigi opened the box, he was speechless.

Ⓐto meet the queen과 동일한 문법적 기능을 하는 것은?
questions.explanation: Ⓐ 'to meet the queen'은 'To get a chance to meet the queen'에서 chance를 수식하는 형용사적 용법의 to부정사이다. 하지만 전체 문맥에서 'To get a chance to meet the queen'의 앞 'To get a chance'는 목적을 나타내는 부사적 용법이다. 'Ⓐto meet the queen'은 'a chance to meet the queen'에서 chance를 수식하는 형용사적 용법이다. ②'to study art'는 went의 목적(부사적), ①은 형용사적(hard to climb), ③은 형용사적(some picture to show), ④는 부사적(감정의 원인), ⑤는 부사적(목적)이다. Ⓐ는 chance를 수식하는 형용사적 용법이므로 ③이 정답이다.

questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 올바르지 않은 문장은?

Jimin went to the park today. She does walking her dog, Molly. They were enjoying their free time. Suddenly, Molly heard something ______ to them. Molly stopped and barked. From the darkness, someone appeared. It was Jimin's mom. Jimin was relaxed when she saw her mom.

Back in Italy, Antonio told his friends about his good fortune. Luigi, the richest merchant in Genoa, heard the story and was jealous. "Cats are ⓐworth Luigi thought. "I'll bring the queen what is really valuable. I'm sure that the queen will give me more jewels." Luigi packed his ship with wonderful paintings and other works of art. He took the gifts to the island. To get a chance to meet the queen, he told the islanders a lie that he was a good friend of Antonio's. When the queen heard about Luigi, she invited him to her palace for dinner. Before sitting down at the table, Luigi presented the queen with all his gifts, and the queen thanked him again and again. "I'll repay you with a ⓑprice gift," said the queen. Luigi watched the queen whisper in a servant's ear. He became excited and hopeful. He was sure that he would receive more jewels than Antonio. After a while, the servant returned with a box, and the queen presented it to Luigi. When Luigi opened the box, he was ⓒspeech. There was a kitten in the box. "Antonio gave us the ⓓprice cats, and we now have some kittens," said the queen. "In return for the wonderful gifts you gave us, we want to give you what is most valuable to us." Luigi realized that, in the queen's mind, the kitten was worth far more than all the jewels in the world. He tried to look pleased with the gift. He knew that was the right thing to do. Luigi did not return home a richer man. But he was surely a wiser one.

questions.explanation: ⓐ worthless(가치 없는), ⓑ priceless(값을 매길 수 없는), ⓒ speechless(말문이 막힌), ⓓ priceless(값을 매길 수 없는) — 모두 '-less' 접미사가 붙어 '~이 없는'의 의미를 만든다.

questions.question:
빈 칸 ⓐ~ⓓ에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절하게 연결된 것은?

Long ago, an honest merchant lived in Genoa, Italy. His name was Antonio, and he went to different places to support his family ⓐ______ trading.

One day, he filled his ship ⓑ______ goods and visited a faraway island. There he traded tools ⓒ______ spices and books ⓒ______ nuts. Thanks ⓓ______ Antonio, the islanders could get what they needed.
questions.explanation: ⓐ support his family by trading: '~함으로써'의 의미인 by, ⓑ filled his ship with goods: fill A with B(A를 B로 채우다), ⓒ traded tools for spices: trade A for B(A를 B와 교환하다), ⓓ Thanks to Antonio: thanks to(~덕분에). 따라서 by / with / for / to가 정답이다.

options: Who was the richest merchant in Genoa?
What made Luigi jealous of Antonio?
Why did Luigi lie to the islanders?
What food did the queen serve Luigi?
What did the queen receive before dinner?

options: merchant: a person who does housework in someone else's house

questions.question:
[지문]
Long ago, an honest merchant lived in Genoa, Italy. His name was Antonio, and he went to different places to support his family by trading. One day, he filled his ship with goods and visited a faraway island. There he traded tools for spices and books for nuts. Thanks to Antonio, the islanders could get what they needed. One night, Antonio had dinner with the island's queen at her palace. When dinner was served, rats appeared, and some servants chased them away with sticks. Antonio was greatly surprised that there were rats in the palace. He asked, "Are there no cats on this island?" The queen looked puzzled. "What is a cat?" she asked.

The merchant said to himself, "What the islanders here need is not tools or books, but cats." He brought two cats from his ship and let them run free. "What amazing animals!" cried the queen when she saw all the rats run away. She gave Antonio a chest that was filled with jewels.

윗글의 밑줄 친 단어에 대한 설명으로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: trade는 '사람들이나 나라들 사이에서 물건을 교환하는 활동'이라는 뜻으로 설명이 올바르다. ① merchant는 상인이지 가사도우미가 아니며, ③ palace는 왕이나 여왕의 궁전(private home이라는 표현은 맞지 않음), ④ puzzled는 '잘 이해하기 때문에 혼란스러운'이 아니라 '이해하지 못해서 혼란스러운' 것이며, ⑤ chest는 플라스틱 가방이 아닌 나무 상자이다.

Luigi watched the queen (A) whisper / to whisper / whispering in a servant's ear. He became excited and hopeful. He was sure that he would receive more jewels than Antonio.

After a while, the servant returned with a box, and the queen presented it to Luigi. When Luigi opened the box, he was speechless.

There was kitten in the box. "Antonio gave us the priceless cats, and we now have some kittens," said the queen. "In return for the wonderful gifts you gave us, we want to give you (B) that / what is most valuable to us."

(A)와 (B)에 들어갈 표현으로 어법상 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: (A) watch + 목적어 + 동사원형(지각동사): 'Luigi watched the queen whisper'에서 지각동사 watch는 목적격보어로 동사원형을 취한다. (B) 'give you what is most valuable to us'에서 what은 선행사를 포함한 관계대명사로 '~하는 것'의 의미이며, that은 선행사 없이 쓸 수 없으므로 what이 적절하다.
